description: Import an existing design into a NEW Ohmstead project. Sources: rows you extracted yourself (read an EPLAN / SKYCAD / AutoCAD Electrical / SolidWorks Electrical PDF page by page: devices with tags + part numbers from the parts list, wires as TAG:TERMINAL pairs from the cross-references / wire numbers, strips with their terminal order from the terminal diagrams), and/or CSV text: wire_csv (connection / wire list export) and bom_csv (BOM / parts list). Devices are matched to the Codex by part number; unknown part numbers are PROPOSED, never created unless listed in accept_parts. BOM lines no wire touches and no Codex part matches (enclosure, hardware) are listed, not placed. Strip numbers are imported locked. level: as-drawn (strips exactly as imported), light (pack, numbers kept), split-pack (split by subsystem + function, pack, numbers kept), full (split, pack, renumber). Device connections are checked to stay identical. Devices with no subsystem hint get PROPOSED subsystems from strip function and how they connect (Power, Control, field groups, areas from numbered tags), never applied unless listed in accept_subsystems; to change one, set subsystem on those device rows and run the dry run again. apply=false (default) returns the report only; show it to the user and ask before applying.

accept_parts.description: Proposed part numbers to create in the user's Codex before importing (["all"] for every proposal whose manufacturer exists)

accept_subsystems.description: Proposed subsystem names to apply (["all"] for every one). Devices left out stay at project level.

bom_csv.description: BOM / parts list CSV text (tag, part number, manufacturer, description, section)

column_map.description: Override column names, e.g. {"fromTag": "Start device", "partNumber": "Order no"}

subsystem.description: Subsystem hint: IEC function, BOM section, page group

tag.description: Device tag as drawn; IEC designations allowed (=PUMP+CP1-K1)

strips.description: Terminal order per strip from terminal diagrams

team.description: Team or class name or id to create the project in. Omit for your personal workspace.

wire_csv.description: Wire / connection list CSV text (EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical, SolidWorks Electrical exports; columns found by name)

signal.description: Potential / signal name as drawn (24VDC, 0V, PE, L1…)

name: import_wiring_list
title: Import a design (wire list, BOM, or a drawing you read)
